items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Smitty? Not Smitty. This other boy. [INTERVIEWEE] Where does he live, you know? He lived downtown. That's somewhere. Where does he look like?

ctx.x: Yeah, I played some drum. And this other boy, he tried to play the piano. What's his name again? Play the piano. He used to play with Sheik. Play the piano. Oh, there's so many. You used to play with Sheik.
Smitty? Not Smitty. This other boy.
Where does he live, you know? He lived downtown. That's somewhere. Where does he look like?
